test_accounting: 1109 parser/expression units, 205 core integration tests, 49 CLI tests, and the feature-enabled native Verilog-A suite. The default-feature invocation of veriloga_source_directive_spellings executes zero tests and contributes no coverage; its explicit veriloga-native run is recorded separately. Sixteen optimized WASM targets execute 153 tests. Development repeats and publication-ledger checks are excluded. No executed test is ignored. Netlist units and Clippy ran immediately before the second commit against identical source bytes; later checks used the committed revision.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of committed Git blob bytes
implementation: Inactive DATA/ENDDATA cards follow ordinary logical-line collection and conditional gating, without evaluating headers/rows or publishing tables. Continuations cannot turn into independent conditional directives. Active tables retain syntax, numeric and configured-limit validation.

Conditional evaluation uses an explicit unresolved state, distinct from true and false. A failed IF or eligible ELSEIF selects no branch for the current pass and prevents later decisions in that chain from sampling or emitting effects. Nesting and structural validation continue.

The first physical condition error shares the existing failed-pass retention contract. Independent later source cards may select TEMP/TNOM, but a fresh source pass must validate every active decision before publication. Existing scoped parameters/functions, source-order sampling, physical overrides, terminal resource/cancellation errors and finite replay budgets remain authoritative.
acceptance_evidence: Two original DATA tests and two IF/ELSEIF temperature tests failed before these changes. Five portable DATA regressions now cover chosen tables, inactive headers/rows/limits, nested statistical phases, active validation and continuation ownership.

Fourteen portable conditional regressions cover IF/ELSEIF/ELSE, nested and subcircuit scopes, completed parent temperature dependencies, no guessed else branch, DATA/model/subcircuit/Verilog-A branch effects, lazy undefined parameters, authored function definitions, inactive literal hints, exact random samples, active resource limits, stable/structural/circular errors and included continuation origins.
An independent current-source/resistor circuit produces the expected 1 V selected-branch DC result within 1e-10 V, allowing the solver default conductance regularization.

Private tests confirm an unresolved chain emits no declarations or later conditional samples, all cancellation boundaries across root/scoped/sampled recovery stop without additional polls, and physical TEMP overrides control selection before authored temperatures.

limits: Subcircuit-header defaults and other earlier card errors can still prevent temperature discovery. Other eager parameter error classes and general statistical/runtime binding remain open.
Inner-loop cancellation, allocation/performance bounds and broader production qualification remain open. No C00-C14 package closes.
Prior Rust 1.94/1.95 compiler and native WASM-runner reliability incidents remain C14 work. CLI runtime qualification uses Rust 1.95; these runs do not establish general toolchain reproducibility.
development_notes: Integrated four newer remote-main CLI VCD/RAW commits before final qualification; their affected converter/input/selection tests are included. An expanded DATA regression exposed lost continuation ownership in the initial gating repair; the final path retains logical cards and the regression passes. Corrected the new DC fixture tolerance to account for default conductance regularization. No existing assertion was weakened. C04 qualification_task is condensed to its current delivery and remaining requirements; detailed historical contracts remain in the plan and indexed evidence records.
